core_principles: widget = descriptor.js + Elem<Name>.vue + panels/ + utils/ + styles/
platform auto-discovers via meta export from descriptor.js
microfrontend: ALL CSS must be scoped — un-scoped breaks other widgets
goodt package imports: root-level only (Webpack Module Federation)
every prop mutation in panel MUST call propChanged('propName')
<w-elem> root for widgets; <w-panel> root for panels — both mandatory
dimension/size props stored as {size, unit} objects; convert with unit2PxMixin
run convertCssVarToComputedValue(opts, computedStyle) before passing to chart libs

component_roles.descriptor.js: declares props, vars, dataset contract, cssVars, panels; exports meta via useDatasetMeta
component_roles.Elem<Name>.vue: extends Elem, dataset mixins, hooks.then, loadData, mounted updateDescriptorVars
component_roles.DatasetPanelMixin.js: watches metrics/dimensions, auto-populates metricsStyle, keeps dropdowns valid
component_roles.panels/config.js: all static option arrays {label, value} for ui-select components
component_roles.css-vars.js: function ({palette, typography}) => ({varName: value}) mapping theme to widget vars

imports: ONLY import from package roots — never sub-paths
naming: directory name must match widget name exactly
Vue files: PascalCase; JS modules: camelCase
panel files: <Name>Panel.vue suffix, located in panels/
boolean data props: is*, has*, can*, should* prefix
array constants end with s; exported constants PascalCase
styling: ALWAYS use <style module> OR namespace wrapper .elem{name}-widget-root
NEVER un-scoped global styles — breaks microfrontend
dimension props: {size, unit} object type (never plain Number)
use unit2PxMixin.takeUnit2Px({value, unit}) for pixel conversion
vue: <w-elem> root mandatory for all widget components
<w-panel> root mandatory for all panel components
call propChanged('propName') after every prop mutation
no inline style="" attributes — use computed properties
no template literal expressions in templates — use computed
destructure nested props — avoid long property chains
dataset: register descriptor vars BEFORE $storeCommit (prevents NOT ACTIVE warnings)
use dimension names as keys (not column IDs)
filter values: always arrays [value] not bare value
panels: use static:{} for non-reactive panel constants
init CSS panel local state in mounted() NOT in watch (reactive loop)

descriptor: dataset.vars: { dimension: { operation: StoreOperation.ALL } } for auto-var generation
meta = useDatasetMeta({descriptor, isChildAllowed, slotNames, cssVars, panels}, {panel: {isMultiple, mixins: [DatasetPanelMixin]}})
all object props use factory defaults: default: () => ({...})
component: hooks.then(results) processes results and triggers redraw
loadData: $requestCancel, isLoading=true, Promise.all(requests.map(r=>r?.send())), catch $handleError, finally isLoading=false
watchEditor for prop-driven redraws with _isEqual guard and $nextTick
dataset_store_variables: filterParams shape: {dimensionName: {__t:-1, name, operator: QueryFilterOperator.EQ, value: [val]}}
panels: static: {} for non-reactive constants available in template
computed get/set pairs for complex nested props
ui-input-units emits string '40px' — convert to {size,unit} in computed setter
gate advanced settings behind ui-has-panel + ui-checkbox pattern
tooltip_slots: isChildAllowed: true + slotNames: ['tooltip'] in meta for slot support
styling: dimension computed: const px = this.takeUnit2Px({value: obj.size, unit: obj.unit})
animation: requestAnimationFrame loop, store ID, cancelAnimationFrame in beforeDestroy
SVG: use viewBox + preserveAspectRatio='xMidYMid meet', HTML overlay for text

priority: 10-official-frontend-docs.md over other playbook files when conflict
stricter rule wins when multiple sources overlap
usage: for deep detail: reference source docs/ai-playbook/0N-*.md by section
